correctness.rationale: PASS: Complete deterministic reset to (x,η) makes successive first-passage excursions i.i.d.; the renewal identity ET_r=(1−Φ(r))/(rΦ(r)) gives initial reset slope H=m1²−m2/2. For passive reflecting–absorbing BM with generator ∂xx, μ=x−x²/2 and M=2x/3−x³/3+x⁴/12; H0 has the simple interior zero c=1−1/√5 and positive derivative 1/(3√5). Differentiating the backward moment equations for the small drift εv yields (γ−∂xx)A=1−x and (γ−∂xx)B=M'(x)+2A with Dirichlet 0 and Neumann 1 boundary conditions. The displayed positive mixed-boundary Green resolvent gives S(γ)=−3√5[2μ(c)A(c)−B(c)/2]. Direct independent quadrature reproduces S(0)=4/125>0, S(0.1)=0.015585415510…, S(0.3)<0 and S(1)=−0.061343172483…; analytic interior resolvent asymptotics yield S(γ)=−1/γ+O(γ^−2). Continuity proves at least one reversal, not uniqueness; IFT gives the local root only for small ε and fixed γ. Moment differentiation is justified by small-drift Girsanov control and bounded-interval killed-process spectral gap, not numerical evidence alone.
